//: The owner's audition format (2026-11-26): one line, five styles, every voice. `instruction` steers models that take written directions (Gemini, Fish Audio). ElevenLabs acts from tags in the text: `script` is the line with tags placed through it (round 2, 2026-11-27, after the owner found round 1 slow and flat); `tag` is the single leading tag round 1 used.
line: Oh look, you made it. Grab a phone, pick a name, and try not to embarrass yourselves.

styles.label: Snarky
styles.script: [sarcastic] Oh look, you MADE it. [scoffs] Grab a phone, pick a name, [mischievously] and try NOT to embarrass yourselves.
styles.instruction: Deliver it snarky: dry, sarcastic and eye-rolling, a smirk you can hear, leaning on the words for comic effect.

styles.label: Mean
styles.script: [annoyed] Oh look. You made it. [angry] Grab a phone! Pick a name! [shouting] And try not to embarrass yourselves!
styles.instruction: Deliver it mean: cutting, contemptuous and impatient, like the guests personally ruined his day. Harsh, but still funny.

styles.label: Indifferent
styles.script: [bored] Oh look, you made it. [sighs] Grab a phone, pick a name, [dismissive] try not to embarrass yourselves. Whatever.
styles.instruction: Deliver it indifferent: flat, bored, low energy, a can't-be-bothered monotone with a little sigh in it.

styles.label: Nice
styles.script: [warmly] Oh, look, you made it! [chuckles] Grab a phone, pick a name, [playfully] and try not to embarrass yourselves.
styles.instruction: Deliver it nice: warm, kind and gentle, genuinely glad to see everyone, like a favorite uncle.

styles.label: Cheerful
styles.script: [excited] Oh LOOK, you made it! [quickly] Grab a phone, pick a name, [laughs] and try not to embarrass yourselves!
styles.instruction: Deliver it cheerful: bright, upbeat and bouncy, full game-show energy, grinning the whole way through.
